exposure: GDM cases stratified by clinical management (diet intervention or insulin treatment)
outcome: mRNA expression of ET-1 and its receptors (ETA and ETB)
Vascular cell adhesion molecule-1 (VCAM1) and intercellular adhesion molecule-1 (ICAM1) expression
cohort: Pregnant women with GDM (n=24) and gestation-matched controls (n=42).  Human omental arteries were also collected from healthy pregnancies and those complicated by GDM at cesarean section.
finding: While circulating ET-1 levels and mRNA expression of the ET-1 system in omental arteries were not significantly different between pregnancies complicated by GDM and healthy controls, insulin treatment during pregnancy and in ex vivo models reduced ET-1 vasoconstriction of maternal vasculature in GDM.
